verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch is an API client and testing tool, not a gateway. Its only monitoring-related evidence is the CLI, which runs collection tests to 'automate monitoring' / 'manage automated API monitoring' and can emit JUnit reports. That is synthetic test-based checking rather than observing live API traffic, so it only glancingly touches the story. missing for 10: live traffic observation, metrics collection/dashboards, request logging of production traffic, distributed tracing integrations (e.g., OpenTelemetry), export to observability backends, independent corroboration.
